body:
### More Paintings 🎨 - DS_DEX_DEV

A Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that lets players upload real PNG images and place them as custom wall paintings.

Author: Dandusnehith
Platform: Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

Overview
More Paintings transforms the way players decorate their worlds.
Instead of cycling through the same vanilla paintings, this mod lets you upload any PNG image—art, screenshots, memes, logos, anything—and place it directly in‑game as a custom painting.

It’s simple, fast, and feels like a natural part of Minecraft Creative building.

Features
Dedicated Creative Tab
All custom painting tools are grouped in a new More Paintings tab.

Custom Painting Item
A special item that stores your uploaded PNG data.

In‑Game Upload GUI
Right‑click with the item to open a clean upload screen and pick a PNG from your computer.

Automatic Size Detection
The GUI shows your image’s width and height immediately.

Wall Placement
Right‑click a wall face to place your custom painting in the world.

Persistent Data
Painting data is stored via block entity NBT and saved with the world.

Built‑in Credit
The GUI includes: Mod made by Dandusnehith.

Requirements
Minecraft: 1.20.1
Forge: 47.2.0
Java: 17 (recommended)
Installation (Players)
Install Minecraft Forge 1.20.1.
Place MorePaintings-working.jar into your .minecraft/mods folder.
Launch Minecraft using the Forge profile.
Open a world and find the More Paintings tab in the Creative inventory.
How to Use
Enter Creative mode.
Open the More Paintings creative tab.
Take the Custom Painting item.
Right‑click while holding it to open the upload screen.
Click Upload PNG and choose your image file.
Check the detected width/height and give your painting a name.
Save/apply the upload.
Right‑click a wall face to place the painting.
Placement Rules & Limits
The image must be a .png file.
Maximum PNG file size: 1 MB.
Paintings must be placed on a wall side (horizontal face).
If no PNG is uploaded yet, placement is blocked with a clear message.
Multiplayer & Sync
Comming Soon.
Visual & UX Notes
Focused on a clean, fast upload flow with clear status text.
The uploader screen gives immediate feedback for file selection and detected size.
Tooltips show whether a painting already has image data attached.
Troubleshooting
If the mod does not load, confirm:
Minecraft 1.20.1
Forge 47.2.0
Java 17
If upload fails:
Check that the file is PNG
Keep the file under 1 MB
If placement fails:
Try a different wall surface with solid support.
Credits

Author: Dandusnehith
